raw: { "answer": "No, there is no way to avoid the EUR 90 fee for Flex refunds. According to the policy, Flex refunds are allowed up to 2 hours before departure, and a fee of EUR 90 per passenger is deducted. If the refund is requested after 2 hours before departure or in the case of a no-show, the refund is reduced by EUR 50. The policy does not mention any exceptions or ways to avoid the EUR 90 fee for Flex refunds.","policy_covers_question": false }
